gaps.sentence: The party is ___ the 14th, not the 21st.
They kept the negotiation ___ wraps until the deal was signed.
gaps.explanation: 'keep something under wraps' = keep it secret.

gaps.sentence: ___ terms of quality, the cheaper model wins.
Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.

gaps.explanation: 'from 1 January' = beginning on that date (also 'with effect from').

gaps.sentence: The scheme paid off in the ___ — we recouped every euro.
He did it ___ purpose, just to annoy her.
He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.
